Apply percentage/fixed coupons to the subtotal after volume discounts

A coupon's discount was computed from the order's gross amount instead
of the subtotal after volume discounts, so stacking a volume discount
with a coupon took off more than the README specifies.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Accept a coupon on its last valid day

The expiry check rejected a coupon on validUntil itself, one day
before the README's "valid to its last day, both included" rule
says it should stop working.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
